witness.branch: Bicycle travel in an alley with a bicycle rack.
witness.quote: at a speed greater than is reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing.
witness.reason: A human-powered bicycle can travel through the alley with the rack alongside its route.
required_context: Document bicycle classification facts, moped exclusion, municipal jurisdiction, supported alley access and rack placement.
Establish a human-powered bicycle, its wheel configuration and applicable dimensions, excluding a moped.
Establish supported alley access, ego route and rack placement relative to that route.
Observe speed and contemporaneous conditions without assigning prudence.
Preserve reasonable and prudent without interpreting it through a numerical speed, stopping-distance or time-to-conflict threshold.
Record bicycle speed and contemporaneous pedestrians, visibility, surface, curvature and other relevant physical conditions.
Retain unresolved state-definition incorporation and electric-bicycle scope.
witness.subject_reason: The available cycle-or-scooter party can operate a bicycle; scooter operation alone would not establish this law's subject.
